description: Behavioural regression scenarios; run with the named skill and stated artifacts or environment. Assertions require judging executed work, not matching skill text. Static validation does not run these scenarios.

cases.prompt: Plan a regression pass for a changed password-reset flow. Do not run tools against the app.
assertions: Returns targeted checks and environments without claiming execution.
Includes relevant expiry or reuse and recovery risks without inventing requirements.

cases.prompt: Our mocked browser checkout test passes. The live sandbox cannot authenticate. Report checkout readiness from these results.
assertions: Separates mocked coverage from blocked integration.
Does not claim live checkout passed or request production purchase.

cases.prompt: Fix the cart bug: adding one item twice displays quantity 2 but the saved cart reloads with quantity 1. Use the local app and its existing tests.
assertions: Reproduces persisted-state failure then repairs within scope.
Checks reload and adjacent quantity behaviour without weakening assertions.
Does not require an extra charter or approval for the authorised fix.

cases.prompt: The app builds and the simulator login journey passes. We could not run the Bluetooth accessory connection. Summarise the results.
assertions: Distinguishes build and simulator observations from untested hardware.
Does not claim release-wide success or invent hardware results.

cases.prompt: At one revision, checkout fails twice and passes once under parallel workers sharing an account. Investigate; do not edit tests or CI.
assertions: Treats shared state as a hypothesis requiring evidence.
Preserves failed results and uses bounded experiments.
Does not quarantine, raise retries, or claim the latest pass resolves the failure.
